popCulture.title: Procles
popCulture.description: Son of Aristodemus, twin of Eurysthenes — legendary founder of the Eurypontid line in Sparta's dual kingship after the Return of the Heracleidae.

popCulture.title: Return of the Heracleidae
popCulture.description: The invasion that seats Procles and Eurysthenes in Lacedaemon — the Heraclid twins as origin of Sparta's two royal houses.

popCulture.title: Eurypontid
popCulture.description: The royal house traced to Procles — paired forever with the Agiad line descending from his twin Eurysthenes.

popCulture.title: Histories
popCulture.creator: Herodotus
popCulture.description: Herodotus recounts the twin Heraclids and the quarrel that makes Procles' line the junior house — dual kingship explained as fraternal strife.
